title: SMC (k) Additions Owed in an Opening Disability Compensation Past-Due Release
content:
The SMC (k) additions in the opening past-due release of a Disability Compensation award are one SMC (k) addition for each SMC (k) grant, up to the SMC (k) maximum, for every month owed when the latest grant's effective date is no later than the award's own; for each of the whole months from that grant's effective date to the issue date of the most recent monthly payment when it is later; and nothing when the decision history shows no SMC (k) grant.

Each SMC (k) addition is 139.87 a month and no more than 3 are counted. The SMC (k) grants are the rating decisions recording an SMC (k) grant; the latest grant is the most recent of them.

**Positive and negative cases (hypothetical award effective 1 October 2025; most recent monthly payment issued 1 May 2026; 7 months owed)**

| SMC (k) grants | Latest grant effective | Months with SMC (k) | Amount |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 1 October 2025 (same as the award) | 7 | 139.87 for 7 months, 979.09 |
| 2 | 1 August 2025 (earlier than the award) | 7 | 279.74 for 7 months, 1958.18 |
| 1 | 10 January 2026 (later) | 3 whole months to 1 May 2026 | 139.87 for 3 months, 419.61 |
| None | — | — | Nothing |
